goals: Verify that base64_decode_image correctly decodes a base64 string into an image object.
Verify that base64_decode correctly decodes a base64 string into a prediction dictionary.
Verify that the ModelService lambda_handler correctly processes Kinesis event records and returns the expected prediction response structure.
activities: Assert that the actual decoded image matches the expected image
Assert that the actual decoded result matches the expected result
Initialize a mock model with a predefined value
Initialize a model service with the mock model and a version string
Construct an event dictionary containing the base64 input within a Kinesis record
Execute the lambda handler with the constructed event to get actual predictions
Assert that the actual predictions match the expected predictions
